DTF Sheet Making — Printer to Powder Shaker Real Machine Process

Aapka PNG pehle PET film par print hota hai — yeh hamare printing partner ka printer hai, Surat mein. Ink geeli rehte hi film powder shaker se guzarti hai: hot-melt powder lagta hai aur machine ek hi pass mein use cure kar deti hai. Bahar aati hai ready DTF sheet — T-shirt par heat press karo aur film peel karo.

Comment mein batao, DTF kis par lagwaoge? 👇
